[alias]
# Keep the local pre-commit gate and CI on exactly the same lint policy.
#
# Production libraries use the pinned workspace `clippy::all` baseline. Unit
# and integration tests are compiled by the separate `cargo check` gate without
# applying library-only style policy to assertion code. Examples are not part
# of the release gate because some require consumer-owned fixtures and setup.
lint = "clippy --workspace --all-features --lib --no-deps -- -D warnings"
